policy.EXACT: Open against the exact retained module/overlay versions.
policy.UPGRADE_AVAILABLE: Do not load silently. Show delta and require explicit upgrade action.
policy.PIN_UNAVAILABLE: Do not claim reproducibility. Original version must be restored to the catalog or the user may explicitly upgrade.
policy.UNPINNED_LEGACY: Legacy saved state may load, but is marked unpinned and should be re-saved under the current governance contract.
